comparison.objective: Clamp a bar in a lathe chuck at specified stick-out and position the cutting tool without contact.
comparison.physical_skill: Bar alignment, chuck-key tightening, and precision tool positioning versus bimanual sifting.
comparison.success_condition: All jaws clamp the aligned bar with 55–65 mm stick-out; tool lies within specified axial/radial gaps and never touches.
comparison.reason: Tests machine-tool setup and clearance control.
